summary: Backend regression passed all 3 critical tests. Mobile UI login, shipyard navigation, calculator options, quantities, and computed values passed; calculator save did not close the modal, blocking subsequent Spaceport navigation.

integration_issues.issue: After clicking Prototyp speichern, the calculator modal remained visible and blocked the Raumhafen tab; Spaceport could not be reached in the end-to-end flow.

action_items: Verify the parent onSave API response and close behavior; ensure a successful save closes the calculator and refreshes ship designs, while displaying an error when the backend rejects the prototype.
critical_code_review_comments: Backend auth initialization and ship-design validation are covered and passed regression tests.
seed_data_creation: No seed data created by this test run.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Login used TestUser1/password123. Calculator options and formulas visibly worked with fusion/titan/plasma and quantities 2/3/4. Save modal remained open, so Spaceport, stance, and Observatory autofill were not reached in this run.
rca_of_issue: The UI flow reaches the calculator and submits save, but the modal remains mounted after the save attempt. The immediate downstream tab click is intercepted by the modal. Inspect the parent callback/API error handling and whether prototype-limit rejection is surfaced or closes the modal prematurely.
